clips.title: The story
paras: Turak Runetotem is a revered tauren druid trainer residing in the Hall of Elders atop Thunder Bluff's Elder Rise. Serving as a trusted assistant to Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem, he guides novice tauren along the sacred paths of nature and balance. Through Turak, young druids undertake foundational trials to commune with spirits and master animal aspects.

Within the serene confines of the Hall of Elders, Turak Runetotem stands as one of the Horde's foremost druidic mentors. Renowned for his deep patience and balanced demeanor, he assists Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem in reviving the ancient druidic arts among the tauren people. Turak ensures that every aspiring druid honors the will of the Earthmother, teaching that physical power must always be grounded in spiritual respect and harmony with nature.

When a fledgling druid is prepared to embrace animal forms, Turak directs them into the wider world. He initiates their communion with the Cenarion Circle, teaching the art of teleporting across Kalimdor to the sacred haven of Moonglade. Recalling the bewilderment and intensity of his own youthful audience with the Great Bear Spirit, Turak tests his students' courage by sending them to face Lunaclaw and obtain the strength of body and heart needed to walk the Path of the Claw.

Turak's guidance expands beyond primal combat forms to environmental stewardship. He sends his disciples back to Dendrite Starblaze to learn about poison, and Dendrite dispatches them to a rash of animal poisonings near the Crossroads, a situation that surprises even Turak. Through these trials, along with the arduous rituals beneath the tides to awaken the aquatic form, Turak shapes novices into enduring protectors capable of healing Azeroth's deepest wounds.
